name: Flowfresh HF
chemistry: polyurethane modified cementitious matrix loaded with Polygiene® silver-ion antimicrobial
positioning: Flowcrete's signature SKU. Polygiene® silver-ion is the key differentiator versus Sika PurCem and Ucrete UD200 — same PU-cement chemistry, plus published antimicrobial efficacy. Food production, meat/dairy/fish, brewery.
source: industry knowledge; Flowcrete Flowfresh published TDS / case studies

name: Flowfresh MF
positioning: Lighter-duty Flowfresh for less-aggressive food zones. Still carries Polygiene.

name: Flowfresh RT
positioning: Thin-section Flowfresh, smooth finish, for back-of-house / mid-aggressive zones.

name: Flowshield SL
positioning: Flowcrete's epoxy SL competitor to Sikafloor-263 SL / MasterTop 1235SL / Mapefloor I 302 SL.

name: Flowcoat SF41
positioning: Flowcrete's thin-film epoxy coating, used in defence + nuclear case study referenced on Flowcrete UK site.

name: Isocrete 1500 Plus

source: Flowcrete 2025 news on 1 tonne packaging launch

name: Flowscreed Industrial Top
positioning: self-leveling industrial topping screed, paired with Isocrete subbase.
